purpose: Teach: 凌/善悪/風刺/訳す/散乱/内需/砦/ノミネート

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の競合、本気で、絶対、凌駕する、絶対、製品、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want us to outpace our competitors. Seriously. With everything we've got. That's what I'm asking.
lines.style: Sharp attack on the opening. Commanding but not theatrical. Measured pace, each sentence landing with quiet authority. Slight pause before the final request—the weight of expectation made clear without raising the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、善悪、絶対、判断、絶対、徹底させております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're making sure every team member upholds those standards—with integrity and full commitment. Thank you for the direction.
lines.style: Respectful and steady. Formal register: the careful diction of someone reporting to a superior. Slightly slower pace on the middle clause, showing diligence. Closes with genuine gratitude, not lip service.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界を、本気で、絶対、風刺する、絶対、報道、絶対、当社、絶対、対応していけ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need us to meet the industry conversation head-on. Monitor what's being said. Make sure our response is sharp and timely.
lines.style: Purposeful, matter-of-fact. Lean forward slightly in the delivery. Medium pace, no flourish. Each directive lands as expectation, not suggestion. Slight exhale on the final clause—the weight of action required.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外の契約書、本気で、絶対、訳す、絶対、社員、絶対、配置しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We have staff positioned to handle international contracts—translation and negotiation. We're on it.
lines.style: Composed and direct. Professional register without flatness. Slight uptick of confidence when naming the capability. Trails off softly on 'we're on it'—assurance without overstatement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 倉庫、本気で、絶対、商品、絶対、散乱、絶対、しないよう、整理、徹底させろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The warehouse needs to be organized. No exceptions. Product placement, inventory flow—get the systems locked in.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. No ornament. Opens with the problem, moves directly to the non-negotiable standard. Slight edge of impatience, but disciplined—this is about standards, not anger.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。内需の動向、本気で、絶対、当社、絶対、注視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're tracking domestic demand closely—staying ahead of the curve on what the market needs.
lines.style: Alert and engaged. Formal but warm—showing that watching the market is not busywork but strategic vigilance. Slight emphasis on 'closely' and 'ahead,' showing readiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の砦、本気で、絶対、当社、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: We're positioning ourselves as the industry leader. Not just a player. A standard-setter.
lines.style: Confident, almost declarative. Opens with conviction. Medium pace, each phrase building on the last. Slight pause before 'A standard-setter'—the vision crystallizing. Quiet pride underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品、本気で、絶対、業界賞、絶対、ノミネート、絶対、目指してまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our new product is going for industry recognition. We're aiming for the nomination—and we'll earn it.
lines.style: Assured and forward-looking. Formal but energized—the difference between compliance and genuine commitment. Slight lift on 'earn it,' showing personal investment. Closes with quiet confidence.
